verdict.rationale: Keycloak's own docs say it can authenticate users with existing OpenID Connect or SAML 2.0 identity providers, configured through the admin console with no application code changes. It also supports account linking across multiple providers. Independent users report integrating many external IdPs for SSO across stacks and setting up Google SSO in a few settings. Missing for 10: provider-specific setup guidance or evidence for Okta and Entra, and Google Workspace confirmation beyond generic Google social login; the first-party evidence is mostly homepage-level claims rather than in-depth brokering docs.
